1. All 3 Heads are recruited in October-November 2020. 2. The lab staff is participated in dedicated 6-week training during the AccLab Bootcamp in November-December 2020. 3. The lab conducted meetings with RR, DRR and CO teams and studied existing UNDP portfolio and priorities. 4. Based on conducted meetings with RR, DRR and CO clusters, the lab identified the 1st Frontier Challenge and developed 100-day action plan.

Output 1 1. 2 new sources of data were identified for the Data Innovation for Development: 1. Social media data for misogyny prevention 2. Satellite data for landslides’ and flooding prediction More than 12 sources for these two types of data were detected. 2. Use of Sense-making and hackathon #DEVELOPMYCOMMUNITY were implemented to map grassroots solutions. More than 3. Civic City Dashboard Hackathon to explore the potential of the innovative data was conducted (in cooperation with SOROS Foundation) 4. Innovative methods such as sense-making and hackathons were successfully used to explore potential grassroots solutions. More than 30 solutions were defined, more than 300 grassroots innovators joined the network 5. Innovative ways to empowerment of women in creative industries were explored; insights and knowledge were used to design the paradigm of Women Creative Lab. First WCL was launched in Osh as in experimental mode in 2021. 6. In collaboration with the UNDP Crowdfunding Academy, an online crowdfunding platform and promotion plan were designed to test innovative development finance in 2022.
Output 2 1. Innovative ways to development of tourism sector in Osh through organization of Training on territorial marketing and area-based development in Osh were explored. The training was supported by the Mayor’s office of Osh city. Based on the results the further steps were designed. 3. Portfolio approach to ensure sustainability of the explored and/or implemented interventions and properly share intelligence produced by Accelerator Lab within learning cycles on the Frontier Challenge “Citizen-empowered community development” was applied
